decisions.reason: Restricting the supplied filler images to pages with huge empty spaces does not change author-name, author-photo identity, source, or byline-placement rules.
The filler-image placement condition does not alter category display, allowed categories, label placement, or any article-to-category mapping.
The source directs where supplied images may be inserted and does not change the confirmed Inter font or its thicker readable treatment.
The supplied filler images are unrelated to the required shape and size of author photos.

The general assembly requirement already includes supplied images; the new conditional placement rule is specifically owned by the article-ending layout requirement and does not replace the issue structure or assembly behavior.
The same source message's separate November-issue decision is already captured by the candidate's message-136 MODIFY, and the filler-image placement change requires no additional date-label update.
Placing supplied images only in huge empty spaces does not necessarily change the pages upload format, even-page requirement, or two-page spread compatibility rules.
The filler-image placement condition does not change the prohibition on red in the Dorian Vale article or the reservation of red for the cover.
The image-placement instruction does not alter the requirement to finalize the table of contents from completed pagination.
The supplied filler images and their placement condition do not change inclusion or end-matter placement of the tribute page.
The source does not add, remove, or relocate any of the required cover-mentioned articles.
The source does not establish any page-number change; inserting images into existing empty spaces does not necessarily alter the final cover references.
